jet_definition: No generation or analysis acceptance cuts. Exactly one stable W+, b and bbar; primary pT(W+b+bbar). anti-kT R=0.5 E-scheme jets on stable quarks1..5/gluons. Radiation jets exclude stable b/bbar before clustering; all jets retain them. No jet pT or rapidity threshold. Absent jets have pT=0. All original signed events/weights retained, with no normalization to survivors or plotted range.
errors: Conditional paired source/shower chunks; one-job pilots use eventwise influences. Hard integration, channel-beta and native-envelope uncertainties separate.
